info.name: Restful Booker - QA API Test Suite
info.description:
Stateful Postman collection for https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com, runnable in Postman or the official Postman CLI.

Flow: POST /auth -> POST /booking -> PUT /booking/:id -> GET /booking/:id -> negative/security checks -> DELETE /booking/:id -> GET /booking/:id (404).

Dynamic variables: token and bookingId are extracted from responses and passed to downstream requests. Ephemeral values are cleared from runtime variables during cleanup.

Security: no production secrets are stored in the collection; the environment contains only the public Restful Booker demo credentials. HTTPS is enforced for non-local hosts.

Run the full collection in order. The negative and cleanup folders depend on state created by the happy-path folder.

item.name: 00 - Smoke
item.description: Stateless health check. Safe to run on its own.

request.description: Health check. Restful Booker currently returns 201 Created with a text/plain body, so the assertion follows observed behavior rather than assuming 200.
